nodes.name: DG Submit
nodes.notes: POST /v1/discogen/process: the Prompt against every domain of the chunk, context website, web_search per the row, the account's default LLM and search provider. One task per 10,000 domains, never split smaller, never parallel. Header Auth credential Discolike API. No credential, 400 (no provider on the account), 402 or a dead API is an error on the task, never a crash.
